propositions: Pandoc 3.6.1 silently corrupts markdown-to-jira conversion by escaping arrows inside code spans, deleting HTML comments, and rewriting `-->` delimiters when naive arrow substitution is applied.

A two-phase lexer must lock complete code blocks, HTML comments, fenced blocks, and four-space indents before classifying remaining text, then apply segmented markdown-to-jira conversion with post-render code-preservation fallback.

An inline-Jira scanner must distinguish unambiguous wiki forms (balanced `{{mono}}`, `[label|target]`, `{color:name}`) from ambiguous ones (`*strong*`, `_emphasis_`) to prevent re-rendering cycles when bullets contain both CommonMark and wiki syntax.

A deterministic corpus of 178 scrubbed bodies (29 code-arrow, 29 table, 120 prose) must maintain >=0.90 body and >=0.95 character coverage ratios across real pandoc conversion with non-vacuous dispatch and change validation.

Integration of pypandoc-binary==1.15 (bundling pandoc 3.6.1) as an optional wiki extra with hard version pinning, real-binary platform gates, and fallback-to-identity when pandoc is absent or conversion fails.
Five-pass idempotency tests prove renderer stability; design splits unambiguous/ambiguous wiki markers to eliminate the two-cycle oscillation that earlier de-stabilized bullet rendering.
